Oh, God, yes. Sleep is... sleep is basically a joke at this point. It’s actually one of the worst parts of all this, because by the time the day is over, I am just physically and mentally drained. Yeah, like I was kind of saying a little bit ago, it’s definitely the latter. It's just... everything. It really doesn't stay on one specific concern at all.
